title: Positivity in the context of Hodge modules and Higgs bundles on Deligne-Mumford stacks
summary: We generalize positivity results due to Popa-Wu and Popa-Schnell for Hodge modules and Higgs bundles on smooth projective varieties to the case of smooth proper DM stacks admitting projective coarse moduli spaces. This paper is the first in a series aiming to generalize results of Popa-Schnell and Wei-Wu on Viehweg hyperbolicity to the setting of DM stacks, and in particular, to certain KSBA moduli spaces.
